votes.motion: Approve LBA Consent Agenda (set public hearing dates of May 16 and June 6, 2023 for the Capital Projects Fund budget of the Local Building Authority for FY 2023-24)
votes.description: Sets public hearing dates to accept comment on and consider adopting the final budget for the LBA Capital Projects Fund for FY 2023-24, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Local Building Authority Meeting and convene as the City Council
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA board meeting and transition to the formal City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve Work Session minutes of February 7 and 14, 2023 and Formal minutes of February 7, 2023
votes.description: Approval of prior meeting minutes for the February 7 and 14, 2023 work sessions and the February 7, 2023 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items E1-E12 (grant applications) to a future consent agenda
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing for twelve grant applications and refers them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Downtown Building Height and Street Activation Text Amendment to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on a proposed zoning text amendment affecting building heights in the Downtown Plan area to allow further Council review and discussion.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the rezone at 792 West 900 South and 875 South 800 West to a future Council meeting for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from M-1 (Light Manufacturing) to R-MU (Residential/Mixed Use) and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer the Airport Title 16 Amendments to a future Council meeting for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed amendments to repeal and replace Title 16 of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to Airports, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Defer the Homeless Resource Center Text Amendment to a future Council meeting for action
votes.description: Defers consideration of an ordinance establishing a process for approving future Homeless Resource Centers and modifying existing standards, pending further Council clarification on key issues.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 09 of 2023 adopting 2023-2024 Annual Action Plan funding allocations (CDBG, ESG, HOME, and HOPWA) with legislative intent to review Community Land Trust and Shared Equity Programs
votes.description: Authorizes grant funding allocations and adopts the One-Year Annual Action Plan for FY 2023-24, including CDBG, HOME, ESG, and HOPWA funding, and approves an Interlocal Agreement with HUD; also expresses Council intent to review Community Land Trust and Shared Equity Programs.

votes.motion: Adopt an ordinance to rezone the property at approximately 865 South 500 East and complete a Master Plan Amendment
votes.description: Proposed rezone from RMF-30 (Low Density Multi-Family Residential) to CN (Neighborhood Commercial) and amendment to the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map to allow conversion of an existing single-family dwelling to commercial use; the motion failed.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 10 of 2023 consenting to inclusion in Salt Lake County's proposed Convention and Tourism Assessment Area (CTAA)
votes.description: Approves Salt Lake City's participation in the Salt Lake County Convention and Tourism Business Assessment Area, which funds district-wide development, programming, and regional incentives for assessed lodging establishments.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (including setting public hearing dates for the FY 2023-24 City Budget and Budget Amendment No. 6, setting a hearing date for the Early Notification Text Amendment, and reappointing M. Nicole Pessetto to the Sister Cities Board)
votes.description: Approves multiple consent items including setting budget public hearing dates, scheduling a hearing on the Early Notification Text Amendment, and confirming a board reappointment to the Sister Cities Board.
